using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Runtime.Tests
{
    public class InsideRuntimeClientLoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogDebug_ReceivedStatusUpdateForUnknownRequest_LogsExpectedMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var messageMock = new Mock<Message>();
            var diagnostics = new List<string> { "diag1", "diag2" };
            var status = new StatusResponse { Diagnostics = diagnostics };

            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.Result).Returns(Message.ResponseTypes.Status);
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.BodyObject).Returns(status);
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.TargetGrain).Returns(GrainId.NewId());
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.Id).Returns(CorrelationId.NewId());
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.SendingSilo).Returns(SiloAddress.NewLocalAddress(0));
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.SendingGrain).Returns(GrainId.NewId());
            messageMock.SetupGet(m => m.TargetGrain).Returns(GrainId.NewId());

            var callbacks = new Dictionary<(GrainId, CorrelationId), CallbackData>();

            var messagingOptions = new SiloMessagingOptions
            {
                CancelUnknownRequestOnStatusUpdate = false
            };

            var insideRuntimeClient = new TestInsideRuntimeClient(loggerMock.Object, messagingOptions);

            // Act
            insideRuntimeClient.InvokeLogDebugForUnknownRequest(messageMock.Object, status);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Debug,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Received status update for unknown request")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestInsideRuntimeClient : InsideRuntimeClient
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;
            private readonly SiloMessagingOptions _messagingOptions;

            public TestInsideRuntimeClient(ILogger logger, SiloMessagingOptions messagingOptions)
                : base(
                    new TestLocalSiloDetails(),
                    new Mock<IServiceProvider>().Object,
                    new Mock<MessageFactory>().Object,
                    new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object,
                    Microsoft.Extensions.Options.Options.Create(messagingOptions),
                    new Mock<MessagingTrace>().Object,
                    new GrainReferenceActivator(),
                    new GrainInterfaceTypeResolver(),
                    new GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver(),
                    new DeepCopier(),
                    TimeProvider.System,
                    new InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache())
            {
                _logger = logger;
                _messagingOptions = messagingOptions;
            }

            public void InvokeLogDebugForUnknownRequest(Message message, StatusResponse status)
            {
                if (_messagingOptions.CancelUnknownRequestOnStatusUpdate)
                {
                    // no-op for test
                }

                if (status.Diagnostics != null && status.Diagnostics.Count > 0 && _logger.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug))
                {
                    var diagnosticsString = string.Join("\n", status.Diagnostics);
                    _logger.LogDebug("Received status update for unknown request. Message: {StatusMessage}. Status: {Diagnostics}", message, diagnosticsString);
                }
            }
        }

        // Minimal stubs for dependencies
        private class TestLocalSiloDetails : ILocalSiloDetails
        {
            public SiloAddress SiloAddress => SiloAddress.NewLocalAddress(0);
            public string Name => "TestSilo";
            public string ClusterId => "TestCluster";
            public string ClusterName => "TestClusterName";
            public string SiloName => "TestSiloName";
        }

        private class StatusResponse
        {
            public List<string> Diagnostics { get; set; }
        }

        private class Message
        {
            public enum ResponseTypes
            {
                Status,
                Other
            }

            public ResponseTypes Result { get; set; }
            public object BodyObject { get; set; }
            public GrainId TargetGrain { get; set; }
            public CorrelationId Id { get; set; }
            public SiloAddress SendingSilo { get; set; }
            public GrainId SendingGrain { get; set; }
        }

        private class GrainId
        {
            public static GrainId NewId() => new GrainId();
        }

        private class CorrelationId
        {
            public static CorrelationId NewId() => new CorrelationId();
        }

        private class SiloAddress
        {
            public static SiloAddress NewLocalAddress(int gen) => new SiloAddress();
        }

        private class GrainReferenceActivator { }
        private class GrainInterfaceTypeResolver { }
        private class GrainInterfaceTypeToGrainTypeResolver { }
        private class DeepCopier
        {
            public DeepCopier() { }
            public DeepCopier<T> GetCopier<T>() => new DeepCopier<T>();
        }
        private class DeepCopier<T> { }
        private class MessagingTrace { }
        private class InterfaceToImplementationMappingCache { }
    }
}
